evidence.quote: I do not believe any of these factors can explain the possible recent increase in r*, but some may conceivably be a contributing factor to an increase in r* in the future.
This will continue to put downward, not upward, pressure on r*.
All of these financing pressures may contribute to a rise in r* in coming years, but only time will tell how large a factor the U.S. fiscal position will be in affecting r*.
One cannot simply claim r* has risen based on gut feelings—there must be a reasonable economic explanation for why it has risen or fallen.

parsed.rationale: The speech is a long-run analysis of r* that is skeptical that it has risen recently, a mild dovish lean, while flagging fiscal deficits as a possible future upward force. It offers no near-term policy, inflation, or labor-market view, so the net stance is roughly neutral.
